source.title: Healing the Healer
source.description: I am in need of your help. My flask was stolen from me by the corrupted treants of Irontree Woods in Felwood. The herbal mixture should help with my wounds, but it will not be enough alone. Bring it to the hot springs of Winterspring. The healing waters there will aid in my recovery.
source.objective: Retrieve the Unusual Flask from the Irontree Stompers and bring it to the Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.
source.completion:
Thank you, <class>. You have saved me much time in bringing my flask to me. With this, corruption will spread much quicker.

Unfortunately, this will be the last time that you will be needed.
